info.name: SomniSense FULL API Tests
info.description:
Complete automated test suite for the SomniSense backend (all endpoints, success + failure cases).
RUN ORDER MATTERS: use "Run collection" with every folder in the given order (each folder stores IDs for the next).
It switches identity by logging in as ADMIN, then OPERATOR, then ADMIN again (one cookie jar is enough).
Setup: import the "SomniSense Local" environment and fill the SECRET values adminPassword and ingestionKey.
The temporary operator password is only kept in a collection variable during the run and cleared at the end.
Creates synthetic demo records only. Not covered (not built yet): predictions, alerts, simulator control, live push.

item.name: 9.1 History oldest first, dropout is null not 0

exec: pm.test("3 readings in order", () => { pm.expect(j.totalElements).to.eql(3); const m = j.content.map(r => r.measuredAt); pm.expect(m).to.eql([...m].sort()); const d = j.content[2]; pm.expect(d.spo2).to.eql(null); pm.expect(d.heartRate).to.eql(null); pm.expect(d.signalQuality).to.eql(null); pm.expect(d.measuredAt).to.not.eql(d.receivedAt); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j.content[0])).to.include('97'); });
pm.test("only the middle one", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.totalElements).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.content[0].spo2).to.eql(95.5); });
